Where Can You Sell Damaged and Broken Cars?

From unexpected storms to car accidents, there are hundreds of reasons why you may need to part ways with your auto, whether it's damaged or broken. Getting a top dollar for it is surely welcome here. In this case, you’ll undoubtedly face the question, “Where can I sell my broken car?” And that’s where you can choose between different options:

  • Salvage and scrap yards: Such companies are widely available in all big US cities, so finding the one near you won’t be a problem. Thus, you can sell your car in a day, regardless of its condition, but the price may be lower than expected.
  • Private buyers: When someone gets interested in buying your broken vehicle, you can set your own price and hope for success. The bad news is that you may need to wait for weeks or months to find a buyer ready to accept this offer. Plus, all the paperwork throughout the entire sales process will be on your shoulders.
  • Rebuilders and mechanics: If you own a rare broken car, it can undoubtedly attract the attention of rebuilders. Also, the local mechanics may offer you a good price for your auto. However, the problem is that it is usually “good” only in their understanding.

Among other available options, you can use the services of insurance companies and auto recyclers. However, if you need to sell your car ASAP but don’t want to get pennies or get scammed, a junk car buyer like JunkCarsUs is here to offer you the best solution!

How To Sell A Damaged Car With JunkCarsUs?

“I want to sell my broken car as soon as possible,” that’s what we often hear from our clients, and, luckily, we know how to help them! By opting for JunkCarsUs, you’ll enjoy our crystal-clear selling process:

  1. First off, access the damage and share the information about your vehicle, including its year, model, mileage, etc. You can use a convenient Car Value Calculator on our website or contact us via phone or email for this purpose.
  2. As soon as we get all the necessary information, we’ll immediately calculate the costs of your damaged or broken vehicle.
  3. You’ll get our estimate, and once you accept it, you’ll set up a time to meet our technicians. They’ll have a look at your auto to verify all the details you’ve provided about it.
  4. We’ll swiftly prepare all the necessary documents to buy your car. The only thing you need to provide us with is a vehicle title (get in touch with our consultants if you’ve lost it).
  5. When our specialists finish the verification, they’ll pay you in cash. After that, they’ll take away your auto, so you shouldn’t worry about towing

How Much Could My Damaged or Broken Vehicle Be Worth?

Although now you know where to sell damaged cars, you probably still wonder how much money you can get for them. A sure way to find out such information is to use the calculator on our website!

To open the curtain a bit for you, we consider such important factors as your car’s year, make, model, mileage, and condition. For example, the minimum cost of a 1988 Toyota 4Runner is $550 if it’s totaled, but if its engine is still running after the accident, the price may reach even $2,100. Also, such characteristics as gasoline residues, new tires, and brakes won’t have an impact on the final value.

Cars With What Types of Damage Does JunkCarsUs Buy?

You can get in touch with JunkCarsUs if you need to sell vehicles with physical damage and other respective types, including:

  • Cars with salvage title: We estimate the damages of salvage autos and offer the highest possible price.
  • Vehicles damaged by natural disasters: Whether you want to sell a fire damaged or water damaged car, we’ll be glad to consider your offer.
  • Non-running cars. In case your automobile has stopped running, you can still get a great deal with us.
  • Cars with blown engines. Our company purchases autos regardless of the condition of their engines.
  • Wrecked and crashed cars. Opt for us to sell your vehicle after an accident.
  • Totaled vehicles. If your automobile is considered a total loss, JunkCarsUs can still help you get the top dollar for your iron horse.
